work.title: La bohème
work.movement: Act IV · O Mimì, tu più non torni

version.note: Acoustic recording of the named excerpt. Performing edition, cuts and studio instrumental substitutions are unestablished. No instrument-by-instrument timeline is supplied; the modern opera full score does not document this session.

performers.note: DAHR and LOC identify the vocal roles and orchestra accompaniment, but not the orchestra’s name, conductor or acoustic substitutions. No individual instrumental timeline is asserted.

date.note: The 17 March date and take 1 are documented by DAHR and LOC. Commons gives only the year 1907. The LOC transfer is a corroborating discographic source, not the streamed file.

place.value: New York, New York, United States
place.note: City/place as stated in the cited recording source; no more precise room or studio inferred.

label.note: Original master and issues are documented. The pressing used by R. Wolfe is not identified; LOC’s Victor 8000 disc does not prove that Wolfe transferred the same pressing.

credits.value: R. Wolfe — transfer credited by Commons; Adam Cuerden — slight hiss reduction attributed from Commons upload context
credits.note: Commons explicitly credits the upstream transfer to R. Wolfe and documents slight hiss reduction. Adam Cuerden uploaded the altered file; his responsibility for the reduction is an attribution from that context rather than an independently named transfer engineer.

date.note: No transfer date established. The Commons, Archive and YouTube upload dates are not treated as digitisation or restoration dates.

processing.value: Slight hiss reduction documented on Commons; parameters unestablished
processing.note: Only the described processing is documented; no equipment, filter settings, pitch correction or speed correction is inferred.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative supplied by Wikimedia Commons; uploaded source: Ogg Vorbis

composition.value: Underlying Puccini composition and historical libretto are public domain where ordinary life-plus-70 terms apply; no modern edition is claimed cleared.
composition.note: Commons marks the historical work public domain. This does not by itself establish the sound recording’s rights; the recording basis is separately documented below.

recording.value: Rule 2 — United States public domain: original sound recording issued as Victor 89006 in 1907, before 1923.
recording.note: DAHR’s original-issue MARC gives [1907]; Moses places Victor 89006 in the 1906–1908 release group. Commons applies PD-US. The upstream Archive item is unavailable, so its original metadata and transfer licence cannot be independently inspected. No separate CC grant or worldwide clearance is asserted.

rights.creditLine: Giacomo Puccini, La bohème: O Mimì, tu più non torni. Enrico Caruso and Antonio Scotti, New York, 17 March 1907; C-4315-1. Internet Archive transfer credited to R. Wolfe, via Wikimedia Commons; slight hiss reduction in the Commons version uploaded by Adam Cuerden.
